name: Pax Gold
issuer: Paxos Trust Company, N.A. (NYDFS-regulated New York trust company)
underlying: Each PAXG token represents one fine troy ounce of a physical LBMA Good Delivery gold bar held in Brink's vaults in London, custodied by Paxos Trust.

terms.min_investment: ~0.01 troy oz (~$20-40) on the Paxos platform; any fraction on exchanges/DEXs
terms.jurisdiction: US (NYDFS-regulated); token itself trades globally, available to US retail
terms.redemption: Redeemable via Paxos for USD, unallocated loco London gold, or physical LBMA Good Delivery bars (minimum ~430 PAXG = one full bar, collected in London); smaller physical amounts via third parties like Alpha Bullion
terms.fees: Zero custody/storage fees and zero Paxos on-chain transfer fee; tiered creation/redemption fees on the Paxos platform; large flat fee (reported ~$15k per request, unconfirmed) plus logistics for physical bar redemption; normal gas on DEX trades

how_to_invest.method: Buy on exchanges (Coinbase, Kraken, Binance) or DEXs (Uniswap, Solana DEXs)

risk_notes: Gold pays no yield; you hold price exposure plus issuer/custody risk on Paxos. Physical redemption is effectively institutional-scale (one whole ~430 oz bar, ~$1.5M+, picked up in London).

name: Tether Gold
issuer: TG Commodities Limited (Tether Gold, redomiciled to El Salvador under its DALMA license)
underlying: Each XAUT represents one fine troy ounce of physical LBMA Good Delivery gold held on an allocated basis in a vault in Switzerland.

terms.min_investment: 50 XAUT (~$170k+ at 2026 gold prices) to buy directly from Tether Gold; any fraction on exchanges
terms.jurisdiction: El Salvador issuer, Swiss vaulting; direct platform excludes US persons and other restricted jurisdictions
terms.redemption: Verified direct customers can redeem for physical gold delivered to a Swiss address (full-bar increments, ~430 XAUT minimum for a bar) or have the bar sold and receive cash proceeds
terms.fees: 0.25% fee on direct purchase and on redemption; zero custody/storage fees; shipping/insurance on physical delivery; gas on transfers

how_to_invest.method: Buy fractional XAUT on exchanges (Bitfinex, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin)

risk_notes: No yield; concentrated issuer risk with Tether-affiliated entity and lighter regulatory oversight than Paxos (El Salvador regime, attestations rather than a US trust charter). Direct mint/redeem thresholds put primary access out of retail reach; retail is secondary-market only.

name: Ondo Global Markets (Ondo Stocks)
underlying: Tokens providing 1:1 price exposure to 430+ US-listed stocks and ETFs (e.g. TSLAon, NVDAon, SPYon), backed by real securities held with regulated broker-dealer custodians and minted/redeemed against Wall Street market liquidity.

terms.jurisdiction: Non-US only — offered exclusively to eligible non-US persons in supported jurisdictions; US persons excluded
terms.redemption: Mint and redeem at prevailing market price 24/5 for the full list; 24/7 instant mint/redeem live since June 2026 for the most-traded names (SPYon, QQQon, CRCLon, NVDAon, TSLAon, GOOGLon)
terms.fees: No explicit platform fee schedule published; costs embedded in mint/redeem spread plus network gas; venue fees apply on CEX/DEX trades

how_to_invest.method: Onboard and mint/redeem on the Ondo Stocks platform (KYC, non-US)
Trade on integrated venues: MetaMask, CEXs, DEXs and aggregators across Ethereum/Solana/BNB

risk_notes: Retail-friendly but strictly non-US; you hold price exposure via Ondo's issuing structure, not direct share ownership (no shareholder voting), with issuer/custodian and regulatory-perimeter risk. First tokenized-stock platform past $1B TVL — larger than all competitors combined.

name: xStocks
issuer: Backed Finance (Backed Assets, Swiss/Jersey structure under an EU/EEA prospectus regime)
underlying: Fully collateralized tracker certificates on blue-chip US stocks and ETFs (TSLAx, AAPLx, SPYx, etc.), each backed 1:1 by the underlying security held with a regulated custodian; tokens are freely transferable SPL/ERC-20s.

terms.min_investment: None on exchanges/DEXs (fractional); primary mint/redeem with Backed is for qualified/professional investors
terms.jurisdiction: Not available to US, Canadian, UK persons (and other excluded jurisdictions); eligible across much of EU, LatAm, Asia, Africa per Backed's EU prospectus regime
terms.redemption: Retail exits via secondary markets (Kraken, Bybit, Solana DEXs, 24/7); direct primary redemption for underlying value restricted to qualified investors onboarded with Backed
terms.fees: No custody fee to holders; exchange trading fees or DEX swap fees; Backed primary market fees apply to qualified investors

how_to_invest.method: Trade on Kraken or Bybit (exchange KYC, non-US/CA/UK)
Swap permissionlessly on Solana DEXs (Jupiter, Raydium)
Primary mint/redeem for qualified investors via Backed

risk_notes: Debt-instrument (certificate) structure, not direct equity — no voting rights, dividends handled via token adjustments; issuer and tracking risk. Explicitly prohibited for US/Canada/UK persons even though the on-chain tokens are technically freely transferable.

name: Ethena sUSDe (staked USDe)
issuer: Ethena Labs (Ethena GmbH / offshore issuing structure)
underlying: NOT a traditional RWA: sUSDe is staked USDe, a synthetic dollar backed by a delta-neutral basis trade — Ethena holds spot BTC/ETH/liquid-staking collateral plus a large liquid stablecoin sleeve and shorts equivalent perpetual futures, so price risk nets to ~zero while the position harvests perp funding rates, staking yield, and stablecoin/DeFi lending yield; sUSDe accrues that yield via a rising exchange rate.

terms.min_investment: None (permissionless staking of any USDe amount)
terms.jurisdiction: Offshore/unregulated for on-chain users; direct mint/redeem of USDe restricted to whitelisted (KYC'd, non-US) approved participants; not MiCA-authorized (delisted from some EU venues)
terms.redemption: Unstake sUSDe -> 7-day cooldown -> withdraw USDe; USDe itself exits via deep DEX liquidity or whitelisted redemption
terms.fees: No deposit/unstake fee; ~10% protocol fee taken from gross yield before distribution

how_to_invest.method: Buy USDe on a DEX/CEX and stake to sUSDe in the Ethena app
Buy sUSDe directly on Curve/Uniswap or use via Pendle/Aave

risk_notes: Yield is path-dependent and highly variable (35% peak in 2024, ~4-5% mid-2026 as funding compressed and backing shifted ~89% to liquid cash/lending); risks include funding-rate inversion, exchange/custodian failure, and the October 2025-style deleveraging events. Insurance fund ~$73M (~1.7% of supply) is the loss buffer.

name: Ethena USDtb
issuer: Ethena Labs (offshore issuer; US issuance transitioning to Anchorage Digital Bank as first GENIUS Act-compliant federally regulated stablecoin)
underlying: A fully-reserved US dollar stablecoin backed by cash and short-duration US Treasury exposure, held predominantly (~90%) in BlackRock's tokenized treasury fund BUIDL — a true T-bill-backed RWA stable, unlike its basis-trade sibling USDe.

terms.min_investment: None on secondary markets; direct mint/redeem reserved for approved institutional parties
terms.jurisdiction: Offshore issuance (BVI structure) moving onshore to Anchorage Digital Bank (US OCC-chartered) under the GENIUS Act; direct minters must be KYC'd approved participants, mostly non-US institutions
terms.redemption: Whitelisted institutions mint/redeem 1:1 against reserves; everyone else buys/sells on DEXs and CEXs
terms.fees: No fee to hold; mint/redeem terms per institutional agreement; reserve yield accrues to the issuer, not holders (GENIUS-compliant stables cannot pay holder interest — venues like Bybit have run separate 5% APR holding promos)

how_to_invest.method: Buy on secondary markets (Curve, Bybit and other CEXs)

risk_notes: Holders get stability, not yield — the T-bill income goes to the issuer. Two-tier access (institutions mint, retail only buys) plus reliance on BUIDL/BlackRock and the Anchorage transition are the main structural dependencies; supply has fallen from its ~$1.4B peak to ~$483M.

name: Re Protocol (re.xyz)
issuer: Re (Resilience Foundation / Re licensed reinsurance vehicles, operating on a Bermuda-style transformer structure)
underlying: Deposit tokens (reUSD senior tranche, reUSDe mezzanine) whose capital collateralizes real-world reinsurance contracts — low-volatility programs like property, trucking, aviation and workers' comp — so holders earn insurance premium yield plus a base money-market rate, tranched by loss priority.

terms.min_investment: No public minimum for reUSD deposits via the app; earlier tokenized fund vintages required accredited-investor-scale tickets
terms.jurisdiction: Non-US persons only (Regulation S) in permitted jurisdictions after KYC/AML; earlier fund products also admitted US accredited investors, but the current token suite prohibits US persons
terms.redemption: reUSD: near-real-time from an on-chain liquidity buffer subject to daily caps, falling back to a quarterly queue if the buffer drops to 1% of supply; reUSDe: quarterly windows only, sized by an independent actuary against regulatory surplus
terms.lockup: reUSD effectively liquid within caps; reUSDe quarterly (capital is deployed as offchain reinsurance collateral); RE staking has lockups/cooldowns
terms.fees: No published deposit fee; yield quoted net (reUSD ~ SOFR + 250bps, currently ~6.4%; reUSDe ~ SOFR + 850bps, currently ~12.3%)

how_to_invest.method: KYC onboarding and deposit into reUSD/reUSDe on the Re app (non-US)
Institutional programs on Avalanche's institutional DeFi ecosystem

risk_notes: Genuine insurance underwriting risk: mezzanine reUSDe absorbs losses before reUSD, and capital is locked in offchain reinsurance collateral trusts with quarterly, actuary-gated exits — this is not redeemable-on-demand DeFi. US persons are excluded from the current token suite despite the protocol's US roots.
